mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WEATHER_REMINDER_TASK ( USER_ID, ORIGINAL_QUESTION, CONCERN_WORD, CONCERN_CONDITION, TASK_TYPE, NOTIFY_CONDITION, LOCATION, TASK_STATUS, EXPECTED_EARLIEST_TIME, NOTIFY_BY_EMAIL, NOTIFY_BY_SMS, NOTIFY_BY_WECHAT, AVAILABLE, DISASTER_LEVEL, EXPECTED_LATEST_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{originalQuestion}, #{concernWord}, #{concernCondition}, #{taskType}, #{notifyCondition}, #{location}, #{taskStatus}, #{expectedEarliestTime}, #{notifyByEmail}, #{notifyBySms}, #{notifyByWechat}, #{available}, #{disasterLevel}, #{expectedLatestTime}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO WEATHER_REMINDER_TASK ( USER_ID, ORIGINAL_QUESTION, CONCERN_WORD, CONCERN_CONDITION, TASK_TYPE, NOTIFY_CONDITION, LOCATION, TASK_STATUS, EXPECTED_EARLIEST_TIME, NOTIFY_BY_EMAIL, NOTIFY_BY_SMS, NOTIFY_BY_WECHAT, AVAILABLE, DISASTER_LEVEL, EXPECTED_LATEST_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES
( #{item.userId}, #{item.originalQuestion}, #{item.concernWord}, #{item.concernCondition}, #{item.taskType}, #{item.notifyCondition}, #{item.location}, #{item.taskStatus}, #{item.expectedEarliestTime}, #{item.notifyByEmail}, #{item.notifyBySms}, #{item.notifyByWechat}, #{item.available}, #{item.disasterLevel}, #{item.expectedLatestTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM WEATHER_REMINDER_TASK WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND AVAILABLE = 1 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM WEATHER_REMINDER_TASK WHERE LOCATION = #{location} AND AVAILABLE = 1 AND DISASTER_LEVEL = 1 AND TASK_TYPE = 1 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT * FROM WEATHER_REMINDER_TASK WHERE LOCATION = #{location} AND AVAILABLE = 1 AND TASK_STATUS = 0 AND DISASTER_LEVEL IN (2, 3) AND CONCERN_CONDITION = #{weatherCode} AND (EXPECTED_EARLIEST_TIME IS NULL OR EXPECTED_EARLIEST_TIME <= #{currentTime}) AND (EXPECTED_LATEST_TIME IS NULL OR EXPECTED_LATEST_TIME >= #{currentTime}) ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
